title: WorkResult
description: The worker → orchestrator envelope (pure-skill architecture v1.0). Everything a worker used to write into shared files it now RETURNS as data; skills/tech-lead/scripts/ingest-result.mjs performs the writes (tick AC boxes, flip board status, append execution log, propagate unblocks, append discoveries) deterministically, in one place. Path: .shapeup/<slug>/results/r<N>-a<M>.json. Every record type is DEFINED CENTRALLY in domain.schema.json — this file only shapes the envelope.

order_id.description: Copied verbatim from the answered WorkOrder — the 1:1 join key.

task_results.description: Per-task outcome. ingest-result flips the board row, ticks GATE-verified AC boxes, and appends the Execution Log from these entries.

escalates.description: advisor-protocol ESCALATE blocks — the worker's one outward port.

discoveries.description: Raw discovered lines. ingest-result appends them to the discovery ledger — the worker never touches the ledger itself.

artifacts.description: Domain artifacts the worker wrote inside its substrate (spec docs, orient/ files, reports).
